_comment: SEC-033: trust anchors for the Windows embeddable CPython that the MSI
embeds. python.org publishes only an MD5 next to each file, and MD5 has
practical chosen-prefix collisions, so it is not a supply-chain control.
It does publish a Sigstore bundle per artifact, which proves the file was
signed by that series' release manager -- a stronger statement than any
hash we could record, and one that does not need a new value per patch
release-manager table, PEP 693 and successors). Verify against that page
issuer_note: cert_oidc_issuer differs per release manager; it is not always Google.
